_comment: Your own rules, checked in order before the built-in logic: the first rule that matches decides. Conditions (all that are present must hold): contains (any of), contains_all, not_contains, starts_with, min_words, max_words. Words are compared without case or accents; "recherch*" matches any word that starts with it; a phrase is several words ("sur le web"). use: "code", "chat", "vision", or a model name. "enabled": false switches a rule off. --model and an image in the conversation win over these rules; --no-route turns them off.
